title: The Role of Social Media in the Capital Market: Evidence from Consumer Product Recalls

scopes.description: The supplied author-package variant consists of the online appendix reporting supplementary and robustness analyses for the paper; no executable author workflow is included.

requirements.description: Author-prepared input data needed to reproduce the supplementary regression analyses in Tables A1–A6. The supplied appendix reports estimates and sample sizes but does not specify the compatible input files, fields, identifiers, full period coverage, or construction workflow.

issues.description: The frozen package inventory contains only the online-appendix PDF; there is no author entry script, README, preparation code, or other executable program from which to run the reported analyses.

The release provides no instructions or code defining the full workflow, required stages, software/runtime, or mappings from the appendix outputs to analysis entry points. Dependency closure and stage order cannot be established from the results appendix alone.

The reported regressions require compatible analysis inputs, but this release does not include data, identify the input products/files, document required fields and coverage, or establish any compatible local or public acquisition route.

evidence.description: The frozen work-item inventory lists one supplied material file, the online-appendix PDF; it lists no author code, README, dataset, or other package file.
The supplied document identifies itself as an online appendix reporting supplementary analyses and robustness checks.
evidence.quote: This online appendix reports the results of additional analyses and robustness checks discussed throughout the manuscript.

evidence.description: Appendix Table A1 reports regression analyses for H1–H3, including sample sizes.
evidence.quote: TABLE A1: Regression analyses using alternative controls for product recall characteristics

evidence.description: Appendix Table A2 documents staged Twitter 2SLS regressions.
evidence.quote: In Section 6.2 of the paper, we discuss the endogeneity and 2SLS related to the Twitter analysis.

evidence.description: Appendix Table A3 reports regression analyses using methods designed to deal with influential outliers.
evidence.quote: TABLE A3: Regression analyses using methods designed to deal with influential outliers

evidence.description: Appendix Table A4 reports the regression controlling for guidance and its sample-period limitation.
evidence.quote: TABLE A4: Regression analyses controlling for guidance

evidence.description: Appendix Table A5 reports the regression controlling for advertising.
evidence.quote: TABLE A5: Regression analyses controlling for advertising

evidence.description: Appendix Table A6 reports the regression on a 352-recall subsample after excluding specified recalls.
evidence.quote: TABLE A6: Regression analyses excluding product recalls where firms directly contact

actions.description: Obtain the author-provided executable replication materials and the input specification needed to assess the appendix analyses.
steps: Request the author README or run instructions, all scripts and supporting programs for the paper and online appendix, their intended execution order, required software and versions, and any manual configuration or inputs.

Request the author-prepared analysis datasets or a data dictionary and full input specification identifying required files, fields, identifiers, time coverage, sample construction, transformations, and any acquisition conditions; clarify which independent analyses produce Tables A1–A6.

If the authors point to a public or restricted source instead of supplying analysis inputs, verify a compatible product and permitted acquisition route against those specifications before recording it as usable.
validation: After materials arrive, map every documented main-paper and Appendix A1–A6 output to its actual entry point and all required supporting stages; verify producer-consumer order and close every dependency.

Confirm each required data input has compatible fields, identifiers, coverage, and a verified route before a separately authorized execution; compare resulting outputs with the reported appendix tables.

review_notes: The frozen dependency checklist is empty. No software requirement or dependency edge is inferred from the appendix because no runnable author code or workflow instructions are supplied.
No analysis-only scope is justified: the package contains no author-prepared analysis data or executable analysis entry point.
